<script>
/* FINAL: fix top icons + remove league preview from feed */
(function () {
  function css() {
    if (document.getElementById('forte-exact-final-css')) return;

    const s = document.createElement('style');
    s.id = 'forte-exact-final-css';
    s.textContent = `
      /* stop old patches making the icons overlap */
      #feed-screen .topbar-actions {
        display: grid !important;
        grid-auto-flow: column !important;
        grid-auto-columns: 50px !important;
        column-gap: 14px !important;
        align-items: center !important;
        justify-content: end !important;
        width: auto !important;
        min-width: 178px !important;
        overflow: visible !important;
      }

      #feed-screen .topbar-actions > * {
        position: static !important;
        transform: none !important;
        margin: 0 !important;
        left: auto !important;
        right: auto !important;
        top: auto !important;
        bottom: auto !important;
        width: 50px !important;
        height: 50px !important;
        min-width: 50px !important;
        max-width: 50px !important;
        border-radius: 50% !important;
        background: rgba(255,255,255,.075) !important;
        display: flex !important;
        align-items: center !important;
        justify-content: center !important;
      }

      #feed-screen .topbar-actions svg {
        width: 30px !important;
        height: 30px !important;
      }

      .forte-kill-league-feed-block {
        display: none !important;
      }
    `;
    document.head.appendChild(s);
  }

  function fixIcons() {
    const feed = document.getElementById('feed-screen');
    if (!feed) return;

    const actions = feed.querySelector('.topbar-actions');
    if (!actions) return;

    const buttons = Array.from(actions.children);

    buttons.forEach(btn => {
      btn.style.position = 'static';
      btn.style.transform = 'none';
      btn.style.margin = '0';
      btn.style.width = '50px';
      btn.style.height = '50px';
      btn.style.minWidth = '50px';
      btn.style.borderRadius = '50%';
    });
  }

  function removeLeaguePreview() {
    const feed = document.getElementById('feed-screen');
    if (!feed) return;

    const nodes = Array.from(feed.querySelectorAll('*'));

    const recipeVote = nodes.find(el =>
      (el.textContent || '').trim().toLowerCase().includes('recipe vote')
    );

    const friends = nodes.find(el =>
      (el.textContent || '').trim().toLowerCase() === 'friends activity'
    );

    if (!recipeVote || !friends) return;

    let pillRow = recipeVote;
    while (
      pillRow.parentElement &&
      pillRow.parentElement !== feed &&
      !(pillRow.innerText || '').toLowerCase().includes('leagues')
    ) {
      pillRow = pillRow.parentElement;
    }

    while (
      pillRow.parentElement &&
      pillRow.parentElement !== feed &&
      (pillRow.parentElement.innerText || '').toLowerCase().includes('recipe vote') &&
      (pillRow.parentElement.innerText || '').toLowerCase().includes('recipes') &&
      (pillRow.parentElement.innerText || '').toLowerCase().includes('leagues')
    ) {
      pillRow = pillRow.parentElement;
    }

    const startY = pillRow.getBoundingClientRect().bottom;
    const endY = friends.getBoundingClientRect().top;

    nodes.forEach(el => {
      if (el === pillRow || pillRow.contains(el)) return;
      if (el === friends || friends.contains(el)) return;

      const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
      const text = (el.innerText || el.textContent || '').trim();

      if (r.top > startY && r.bottom < endY) {
        if (
          text.includes('View all') ||
          text.includes('Private') ||
          text.includes('IRON SHARPENS IRON') ||
          text.includes('Iron sharpens Iron') ||
          text.toLowerCase().includes('your leagues')
        ) {
          let target = el;

          while (
            target.parentElement &&
            target.parentElement !== feed &&
            target.parentElement.getBoundingClientRect().top > startY &&
            target.parentElement.getBoundingClientRect().bottom < endY
          ) {
            target = target.parentElement;
          }

          target.classList.add('forte-kill-league-feed-block');
        }
      }
    });
  }

  function wirePills() {
    const feed = document.getElementById('feed-screen');
    if (!feed) return;

    Array.from(feed.querySelectorAll('button, div, a')).forEach(el => {
      const txt = (el.textContent || '').trim().toLowerCase();

      if (txt.includes('leagues') && txt.length < 35) {
        el.onclick = e => {
          e.preventDefault();
          e.stopPropagation();
          showScreen('leagues');
        };
      }

      if (txt.includes('recipes') && !txt.includes('vote') && txt.length < 35) {
        el.onclick = e => {
          e.preventDefault();
          e.stopPropagation();
          showScreen('nutrition');
          setTimeout(() => {
            if (typeof openRecipes === 'function') openRecipes();
            else if (typeof loadRecipes === 'function') loadRecipes('mine');
          }, 150);
        };
      }

      if (txt.includes('recipe vote') && txt.length < 40) {
        el.onclick = e => {
          e.preventDefault();
          e.stopPropagation();
          showScreen('nutrition');
          setTimeout(() => {
            if (typeof openRecipeVote === 'function') openRecipeVote();
            else if (typeof showRecipeVote === 'function') showRecipeVote();
            else if (typeof loadRecipeVote === 'function') loadRecipeVote();
          }, 150);
        };
      }
    });
  }

  function run() {
    css();
    fixIcons();
    removeLeaguePreview();
    wirePills();
  }

  const oldShowScreen = window.showScreen;
  window.showScreen = function (name) {
    const out = oldShowScreen.apply(this, arguments);
    if (name === 'feed') {
      setTimeout(run, 100);
      setTimeout(run, 500);
    }
    return out;
  };

  const oldLoadFeedPosts = window.loadFeedPosts;
  if (typeof oldLoadFeedPosts === 'function') {
    window.loadFeedPosts = async function () {
      const out = await oldLoadFeedPosts.apply(this, arguments);
      setTimeout(run, 100);
      setTimeout(run, 500);
      return out;
    };
  }

  setTimeout(run, 300);
  setTimeout(run, 1000);
  setTimeout(run, 2000);
})();
</script>

  function feedActive() {
    return document.getElementById('feed-screen')?.classList.contains('active');
  }

  function realTop() {
    return (
      window.scrollY <= 2 &&
      document.documentElement.scrollTop <= 2 &&
      document.body.scrollTop <= 2
    );
  }

  function fixIcons() {
    const feed = document.getElementById('feed-screen');
    if (!feed) return;

    const actions = feed.querySelector('.topbar-actions');
    if (!actions) return;

    const items = Array.from(actions.querySelectorAll('button, a, .icon-btn, div'));

    const msg = items.find(el => {
      const x = ((el.id || '') + ' ' + (el.className || '') + ' ' + (el.getAttribute('onclick') || '') + ' ' + el.innerHTML).toLowerCase();
      return x.includes('message') || x.includes('chat') || x.includes('dm');
    });

    const bell = items.find(el => {
      if (el === msg) return false;
      const x = ((el.id || '') + ' ' + (el.className || '') + ' ' + (el.getAttribute('onclick') || '') + ' ' + el.innerHTML).toLowerCase();
      return x.includes('notif') || x.includes('bell');
    });

    if (msg) {
      msg.classList.add('forte-hard-msg');
      msg.innerHTML = `
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none">
          <path d="M7.5 18.2H7.1C4.45 18.2 2.75 16.55 2.75 14V8.65C2.75 6.1 4.45 4.45 7.1 4.45H16.9C19.55 4.45 21.25 6.1 21.25 8.65V14C21.25 16.55 19.55 18.2 16.9 18.2H12.25L8.15 21.05C7.85 21.25 7.5 21.05 7.5 20.7V18.2Z" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.15" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
          <path d="M8 11.35H16" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.15" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        </svg>
      `;
    }

    if (bell) bell.classList.add('forte-hard-bell');
  }

  function removeLeagueArea() {
    const feed = document.getElementById('feed-screen');
    if (!feed) return;

    const all = Array.from(feed.querySelectorAll('*'));

    const viewAll = all.find(el => {
      const text = (el.textContent || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
      return text.includes('view all') && r.top > 350 && r.top < 800;
    });

    if (!viewAll) return;

    let block = viewAll.parentElement;

    while (
      block &&
      block.parentElement &&
      block.parentElement !== feed &&
      block.parentElement.innerText &&
      block.parentElement.innerText.includes('View all') &&
      block.parentElement.innerText.length < 700
    ) {
      block = block.parentElement;
    }

    if (block) block.classList.add('forte-force-remove');

    // Remove the league cards immediately after View all too
    let next = block ? block.nextElementSibling : null;
    let count = 0;

    while (next && count < 4) {
      const txt = next.innerText || '';
      if (txt.toLowerCase().includes('friends activity')) break;

      if (
        txt.includes('IRON SHARPENS') ||
        txt.includes('Iron sharpens') ||
        txt.includes('Private') ||
        txt.includes('League')
      ) {
        next.classList.add('forte-force-remove');
      }

      next = next.nextElementSibling;
      count++;
    }

    // Emergency backup: hide any visible league cards before Friends Activity
    all.forEach(el => {
      const txt = el.innerText || '';
      const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();

      if (
        r.top > 350 &&
        r.top < 900 &&
        txt.length < 500 &&
        (
          txt.includes('IRON SHARPENS') ||
          txt.includes('Iron sharpens') ||
          txt.includes('Private')
        )
      ) {
        el.classList.add('forte-force-remove');
      }
    });
  }

  function stopBadRefresh() {
    if (window.__forteHardRefreshStop) return;
    window.__forteHardRefreshStop = true;

    let startY = 0;
    let startedAtTop = false;
    let allowRefresh = false;

    document.addEventListener('touchstart', e => {
      if (!feedActive()) return;
      startY = e.touches[0].clientY;
      startedAtTop = realTop();
      allowRefresh = false;
    }, true);

    document.addEventListener('touchmove', e => {
      if (!feedActive()) return;
      const diff = e.touches[0].clientY - startY;
      allowRefresh = startedAtTop && realTop() && diff > 140;
    }, true);

    document.addEventListener('touchend', () => {
      if (!feedActive()) return;

      if (!allowRefresh) {
        window.__blockFeedReload = Date.now() + 1200;
        document.getElementById('forte-pull-refresh')?.remove();
        document.getElementById('forte-pull-refresh-final')?.remove();
        document.getElementById('forte-pull-refresh-correct')?.remove();
        document.getElementById('forte-real-pull-refresh')?.remove();
      }

      startedAtTop = false;
      allowRefresh = false;
    }, true);

    if (typeof window.loadFeedPosts === 'function' && !window.__realLoadFeedPostsHard) {
      window.__realLoadFeedPostsHard = window.loadFeedPosts;
      window.loadFeedPosts = async function () {
        if (feedActive() && Date.now() < (window.__blockFeedReload || 0)) return;
        return await window.__realLoadFeedPostsHard.apply(this, arguments);
      };
    }

    if (typeof window.loadStories === 'function' && !window.__realLoadStoriesHard) {
      window.__realLoadStoriesHard = window.loadStories;
      window.loadStories = async function () {
        if (feedActive() && Date.now() < (window.__blockFeedReload || 0)) return;
        return await window.__realLoadStoriesHard.apply(this, arguments);
      };
    }
  }

  function run() {
    addStyle();
    fixIcons();
    removeLeagueArea();
    stopBadRefresh();
  }

  const oldShowScreen = window.showScreen;
  window.showScreen = function () {
    const out = oldShowScreen.apply(this, arguments);
    setTimeout(run, 100);
    setTimeout(run, 500);
    return out;
  };

  setTimeout(run, 300);
  setTimeout(run, 1000);
  setTimeout(run, 2000);
})();
</script>
